cli_usage:
Mak3P audio-to-MP3 converter

Usage:
  Mak3P-cli inspect FILE [options]
  Mak3P-cli convert FILE [options]
  Mak3P-cli batch FILE... [options]

Options:
  --bitrate 128|160|192|224|256|320
  --channels auto|stereo|mono
  --output-dir DIRECTORY
  --folder-import
  --include-mp3
  --force-upsampling
  --workers auto|0|1..64
  --log
  --config FILE
  --save-settings
  --ffmpeg EXECUTABLE
  --ffprobe EXECUTABLE

Batch conversion supports Ctrl+C cancellation.
cli_invalid_arguments: The command or one of its options is invalid.
lower_bitrate: The source bitrate is below the minimum supported output rate of 32 kbps — skipped. Enable Force upsampling to convert.
bitrate_unknown: Source bitrate is unknown. The selected target will be used; an increase in bitrate cannot be ruled out.
invalid_workers: Choose auto, 0, or a worker count between 1 and 64.
invalid_output_mode: Choose source folders or a custom output directory.
invalid_output_directory: Choose a custom output directory before using that output mode.
settings_read_failed: Settings could not be read. Default settings are being used.

batch_busy: Wait for the current operation to finish before changing the queue or settings.
batch_failed: The batch could not finish normally.
log_create_failed: The log could not be created beside the application. Conversion will continue without a log.

bitrate_adjusted: Output bitrate adjusted from the requested {requested} kbps to {effective} kbps to avoid increasing the source bitrate.
